research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free review of shared mathematical prerequisites with original context and non-merge restrictions.

aliases.reason: The 'scheme' source and 'affine scheme' source both invoke isomorphism of locally ringed spaces, meaning a two-sided inverse among morphisms preserving stalk-local ring structure. Scheme, affine and sheaf-local hypotheses remain in their parent definitions.

The topological boundary expression cl_X(A)\int_X(A) uses the same relative set complement C\I as the sigma-algebra difference axiom A\B. Closure and interior are independently typed sources and not transferred into set difference.

The constructible-set source uses U\V for retrocompact open U,V, an instance of the binary set difference A\B in the sigma-algebra source. Retrocompactness and openness are extra parent hypotheses, not generic properties of difference.

The boundary formula's X\A is the relative complement of A in ambient set X, a special case of A\B. The ambient X and subsequent topological closure remain source-specific; no identification is made between complement and closure.

Noetherian modules and Noetherian rings both invoke existence of an inclusion-maximal member of every nonempty poset family of respectively submodules or ideals. The abstract maximal-versus-greatest predicate is the same; the eligible family type and Noetherian properties are not identical.
